seo.title: Coupang: multi-surface AI recommendation and personalization at scale (2023)
seo.meta_description: Coupang's ML platform powers recommendation, search, and ads across all its apps, with more than 600 ML projects and 100,000 workflow runs a year.
seo.resume_citable: Coupang runs an in-house ML platform that powers recommendation, search, and ads across all its apps, with more than 600 ML projects and more than 100,000 workflow runs a year, adopted by all its major ML groups.

faq.q: What is Coupang's ML platform for?
faq.a: It industrializes the training and productionization of the models that personalize the home feed, search, and ads across the Coupang apps.

faq.q: Does Coupang publish a conversion gain attributed to recommendation?
faq.a: No. What is publicly documented is the scale of the deployment (more than 600 ML projects) and the confirmation of AI investment in financial results, not a per-surface lift.

objectif_business: Personalize every surface of the app (home, search, ads) and industrialize the productionization of models to support both revenue growth and operational efficiency.
description: Coupang runs an in-house foundation, the Coupang ML Platform, which industrializes the model lifecycle end to end: exploration, training data preparation, development, and productionization. This foundation powers the recommendation and personalization surfaces of the app (home feed, search, product ads) across Coupang shopping, Coupang Eats, and Coupang Play, as well as price forecasting and search query understanding via language models. According to the engineering blog published in September 2023, all of Coupang's major ML groups use one or more of the platform's services, with more than 100,000 workflow runs over a year across more than 600 ML projects. Coupang presents AI as a long-term lever for revenue growth and margin expansion.

resultats.metrique: Q3 2025 net revenues, +18% year-on-year (company scale, not attributed to AI)

niveau_preuve.justification: Coupang's official engineering blog (interested source, infrastructure figures) and the public company's financial results for measuring scale. Coupang does not publish a conversion gain attributed precisely to recommendation; what is proven is an industrialized, durable deployment (more than 600 ML projects, more than 100,000 runs a year) and a scale confirmed in financial results. C out of caution, absent a quantified per-surface lift.

stack_technique.detail: in-house MLOps platform that industrializes exploration, data preparation, training, and productionization (more than 100,000 workflow runs a year, 600+ projects)
in-house models that personalize the home feed, search, and ads across Coupang, Coupang Eats, and Coupang Play
Korean variant of BERT integrated by Coupang for search query understanding
in-house price forecasting models fed by the same platform

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Near real-time recommendation on each surface; continuous training and productionization via the platform
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Coupang's ML groups, supported by the in-house ML platform that standardizes training and deployment
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: Browsing and purchase behavior per surface. If the feedback data (clicks, purchases) is not clean and fresh, recommendations drift.

etapes.detail: The platform prepares the training data from customer behavior per surface.
The ML groups develop and train the recommendation, search, and price models via the platform.
The models are deployed on the app's home feed, search, and ads.
Clicks and purchases feed back into training to adjust the recommendations.

prerequis_orga: An ML industrialization platform (training, deployment, monitoring)
A measurement loop on engagement and conversion
replication.premiere_etape: Set up a clean feedback loop on a single surface (for example the home feed) before extending to search and ads.

playbook.action: Choose a single surface (for example the home feed) and audit the available behavior logs.
playbook.livrable: Clean training dataset on the chosen surface

playbook.action: Build the feedback loop (clicks, purchases) and the reproducible training pipeline.
Train a first recommendation model and deploy it in an A/B test on a fraction of traffic.
playbook.livrable: Model in production on a limited share of traffic

playbook.action: Measure engagement and conversion against the existing heuristic, iterate on the features and the ranking.
playbook.livrable: Quantified review and winning model generalized on the surface

playbook.action: Industrialize (monitoring, regular retraining) and extend to a second surface such as search.
playbook.livrable: Reusable MLOps foundation and second surface underway

replication.equipe: 2 data scientists + 1-2 ML engineers + 1 PM, with a data platform team in support

statut_vivant.note: The ML platform has been in production for several years according to Coupang's engineering blog. The Q3 2025 results confirm the scale of the business, but the release itself contains no statement about AI: the programme's liveness rests on the engineering source, not on the financial results.

transposable_ue.note: A multi-surface recommendation and personalization engine (home feed, search, ads) is an e-commerce standard, transposable to the EU. The point of attention is GDPR on the use of browsing and purchase history to personalize, and the transparency expected on ad ranking. The real difficulty is engineering and data, not geography.
